dayToDay.notes: Students are with their guide group essentially the entire trip, sleeping outdoors at shared backcountry campsites, with a staff-to-camper ratio of at least 2 staff per 10 youth. Days are highly structured: hiking, a daily morning meeting, evening group activities and a campfire, and shared meals prepared together. There's no cell service in the backcountry, so there's no phone or text contact with family during the trip — guides send a nightly satellite check-in to the office, not to parents, consistent with the program's "no news is good news" approach. Parents receive a recap email with photos and a daily journal about 1–2 weeks after the trip ends.
